title: P104: lift conditional κ to 0.003898171 via constructive 7-move binary reduction on the retimed multiplier
body:
The selected frontier remains on canonical `main`; independent scientific acceptance is open.

## Summary

This contribution constructs and verifies a 6-round (`k=2..7`) rewrite of the 36-call, 111-port strong binary word (`strong-bit-k7.json.gz`), rebased onto Ali Romman's unpowered retimed multiplier architecture ([PR #8042](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8042)) and benchmarked against Clear1nsight's retimed dyadic endpoint ([PR #8050](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8050), `κ ≥ 0.003890115286594461`) as well as Ali Romman's concurrent quadratic-sum setup reduction ([PR #8051](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8051), `κ = 0.003890115286594445`, setup ceiling `2^241`).

Leaving the 2-scale `(1, 8)` Gaussian receiver **100% unmodified** (`GAUSSIAN_C = 2092819/2^29`) and retaining `log₂_fixed_setup_and_install ≤ 513`, reducing the binary circuit eliminates the binary coupling bottleneck (`BINARY_C` rises from `287039844436133239/2^66 ≈ 0.003890115286594461` to **`4391986206293/2^50 ≈ 0.003900867368050091`**), reduces the binary hierarchy from 7 stages to **2 small stages `(60,000, 960,000)`**, shrinks public activation `A` by more than `10¹²×`, and lifts conditional `κ` across matched, compact, and extended profiles under the exact same five inherited all-size P104 premises:

- [Package overview (`README.md`)](https://github.com/SYLforge/integer-mult-bounds/blob/baaec65bf8e4c7e92be110a00d5b06522177931f/research/p104-k7-retimed-binary/README.md) · [Exact numerical receipts (`RESULT.json`)](https://github.com/SYLforge/integer-mult-bounds/blob/baaec65bf8e4c7e92be110a00d5b06522177931f/research/p104-k7-retimed-binary/RESULT.json) · [Constructive 6-round ledger (`K7-STACK-LEDGER.json`)](https://github.com/SYLforge/integer-mult-bounds/blob/baaec65bf8e4c7e92be110a00d5b06522177931f/research/p104-k7-retimed-binary/K7-STACK-LEDGER.json) · [Binary replay & negative control (`check_binary_k7.py`)](https://github.com/SYLforge/integer-mult-bounds/blob/baaec65bf8e4c7e92be110a00d5b06522177931f/research/p104-k7-retimed-binary/check_binary_k7.py)

## What Changed in the Binary Word (`strong-bit-k7.json.gz`)

- **Checksums**:
  - `strong-bit-k7.json.gz` SHA-256: `9e7392c52bcf29c0cc58c54c619f95c28f476394c33e8e0a5aa30c9557d31362`
  - Decompressed raw JSON SHA-256: `f4a43e4e36ac734dea10a73dca496bf4a4f4a9804b903ea379483d0513d7abc3`
- **Constructive delta over PR `#8027` baseline** (6 recorded optimization rounds `k=2..7` in `K7-STACK-LEDGER.json`):
  - `MOVE` count: `2803 -> 2796` (`-7`) across the 36 `LOCAL` events
  - Dirty private clears: `3433 -> 3426` (`-7`)
  - Charts / delta gates: `636` frames preserved; `2352 -> 2353` delta pairs; `44,825 -> 44,734` rational frame gates
  - Paid cuts / linear sum: `104,904 -> 104,652` paid ports (`-252`; linear rank sum `285,600 -> 284,592`) over the exact same `18,906` productive targets (linear rank sum `286,098`)
  - Exact register forms: symbolically replayed across all `630` registers (`111` ports) in `check_binary_k7.py` and checked in non-constant `mod 3` (1 column) and `mod 9` (2 columns) sparse weighted bank checks.
- **Negative control**: `check_binary_k7.py` loads PR `#8027`'s original `strong-bit.json.gz` (`74e93daf2b7acf794ffb51f92f03f51556f68126d41ee13a8969bddb4cbe6326`) directly from `predecessor/predecessor-8030.tar.gz` and asserts that unpowered `certify(BINARY_C)` rejects it.
- **Bottleneck shift**: With binary moment capacity raised above `0.003900867`, the binary ceiling ceases to govern; `GAUSSIAN_C = 2092819/2^29 ≈ 0.003898179` minus `39/(256 * numerical_H)` becomes the active limit.

## Verification

Full local package replay run from clean `0618e75a` (`#7257`) base via [VERIFY.json](https://github.com/SYLforge/integer-mult-bounds/blob/baaec65bf8e4c7e92be110a00d5b06522177931f/research/p104-k7-retimed-binary/VERIFY.json):

```bash
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-k7-retimed-binary
```

- Code/data full 8-mode run (`binary`, `cost`, `schedule`, `install`, `physical`, `receiver`, `slabs`, `product`): **`PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-k7-retimed-binary outcome=completed`** (`597.74 s`, exit code `0`), ending with `physical_product(EXTENDED)` at `numerical_H = 20,000,000` (`product = -345550037539`, `shuttles = 138`, `coefficients_prefix = [11811, 10996, 4152, 868, 77]`).
- Subsequent documentation-only & `TASK.json.author` updates were re-checked on commit `baaec65bf8e4c7e92be110a00d5b06522177931f`: **`PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`**.

## Predecessor Attribution ([`NOTICE.md`](https://github.com/SYLforge/integer-mult-bounds/blob/baaec65bf8e4c7e92be110a00d5b06522177931f/research/p104-k7-retimed-binary/NOTICE.md))

Built on prior work in `CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds` (Apache-2.0):
- **Ali Romman** (`#8027`, `#8030`, `#8040`, `#8042`, `#8051`): 111-port strong binary catalogue/word, retimed 2-scale `(1, 8)` architecture, transport/clock machinery, and verifier suite.
- **Clear1nsight** (`#8031`–`#8050`): powered 6-stage retimed margin construction (`#8035`), dyadic endpoint analysis (`#8050`), and binary vs Gaussian sensitivity benchmarks.
- **ToikY** (`#8026`, `#8029`), **DreamingOfClouds** (`#7852`), and **Jerry Chen / CubeJerry** (`#7257`, `#7914`, `#7981`): outer-caller groundworks, physical bank interpreter, weighted sparse oracle, counted compiler, and research-package CI harness (`0618e75a`).

## Scope, Inherited Obligations, and Limitations

- **Base dependency note**: Like PR `#8050`, this branch is rooted on the `#7257` snapshot repair commit `0618e75a22cec54d1651394ef83d088551b7f026` (parent: canonical `main` `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`) solely so the historical CI gate stays aligned. All modifications are confined exclusively to `research/p104-k7-retimed-binary/` (48 files).
- **Conditional premises**: Remains conditional on the five inherited all-size framework obligations: `native_all_columns`, `owned_erasure_and_restoration`, `compiler_transfer`, `precision_and_tape_services`, and `analytic_recovery`.
- **Finite replay vs full proof / production size**: Executable replays cover finite register forms, sparse `mod 3` / `mod 9` tests, exact transport intervals, and finite product `physical_product(EXTENDED)` (`-345550037539`); they do **not** constitute production-scale payload execution or independent Lean 4 proofs of `seed_k7` or the five inherited obligations.
- **AI-assistance disclosure**: Constructive binary graph optimization tooling, package adaptation, and verification checks were developed with AI coding assistance and verified by executing the full `scripts/research_package.py` suite on clean temporary installs.

## Open next questions

1. **Gaussian supplier bottleneck (`0.00389818 -> 0.00390086+`)**: Because `seed_k7` removes the binary ceiling up to `0.003900867`, rewriting or tightly retuning the 48-call, 2-scale `(1, 8)` complex supplier (`GAUSSIAN_C = 2092819/2^29`) becomes the direct next lever to push `κ` above `0.00389818`.
2. **Combining with PR `#8051` quadratic-sum setup**: Integrating `strong-bit-k7.json.gz` with [PR #8051](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8051)'s polynomial-space quadratic-sum atlas (`log₂ S ≤ 241`) would pair higher `κ` with smaller fixed setup.
3. **Lean 4 formalization & independent all-size audit**: Mechanizing the 7 removed binary `MOVE` transitions and dirty-clear accounting alongside an independent audit of all five inherited obligations remains open.
